messages:
Alex (AE): Quick thread to align POC scope for Nexera Insurance — they want automated claim intake: entity extraction, PHI redaction, and routing to downstream systems. Need: success criteria, timeline, and explicit security/compliance asks. @Priya can you scope? @Marta / @Olivia looped for DPA/SOC2/pen-test items.

Priya (SE): TL;DR proposed POC scope:
- Ingest sample claim PDFs (redacted subset) -> extract claimant name, policy id, incident date, sensitive PHI flags
- Automatic redaction step that blanks PHI in the generated output before downstream send
- Routing decision: model returns one of {auto-approve, needs-human, escalate} with confidence score

Success criteria (concrete):
1) Extraction F1 >= 0.90 on provided eval set (50 labelled claims)
2) Redaction recall for PHI entities >= 0.98 (no PHI leakage in outputs)
3) Routing precision for "auto-approve" >= 0.92 and overall latency p95 < 350ms
4) No retention of raw PHI after processing (see Marta's requirements)

Suggested POC timeline: 4 weeks
- Week 0: data exchange + security kickoff
- Week 1: model + prompt baseline, deploy dev endpoint, run initial evals
- Week 2: iterate on prompts and redaction rules, integrate routing
- Week 3: stability + throughput tuning, run regression evals and canary test
- Week 4: deliver report, handoff and run final acceptance evals

Sample eval prompt set (for the 50 labelled claims):
```
# prompt 1 (entity extraction)
"Extract claimant_name, policy_id, incident_date from text: <CLAIM_TEXT>"
# prompt 2 (redaction)
"Redact PHI in the text and replace with [REDACTED] tags: <CLAIM_TEXT>"
# prompt 3 (routing)
"Based on the claim, return one token from {auto-approve, needs-human, escalate} and a confidence float between 0-1."
```

Priya (SE): For the POC we recommend hosted endpoints with dedicated routing to a reserved pool (to hit latency SLOs). If Nexera insists on no customer data leaving network boundary, we can propose Private deployment but timeline shifts + infra coordination.

Marta (Security): High-level security checklist and asks from compliance side:
- DPA signed up front (we have a template)
- Provide SOC 2 Type II report (we'll share Redwood's) and our penetration test summary
- For PHI workloads: confirm customer role — are we processing PHI on behalf of Nexera? If yes, we need BAAs (HIPAA) and explicit BAA flow.
- Data handling: default: ephemeral tokenization and no raw storage. For this POC we need to set retention to 0-30 days (customer choice). No logs that contain raw PHI.
- KMS integration: customer-managed keys (recommended) or Redwood-managed keys with strict access controls
- Pen-test: customer may request scope. We require a signed scoping doc and a 2-week scheduling window. External pentest on hosted infra will be scoped to the customer tenant only.
- GDPR: Data subject rights handling plan, SCCs if EU customer, and records of processing for the POC.

Marta (Security): Timeline for artifacts: we can provide SOC2 report + security attestation within 48 business hours after legal confirms NDA/DPA. Pen-test scheduling needs minimum 2 weeks lead time; final report delivery ~2-3 weeks after test completes.

Jordan (SRE): Notes on deployment options / infra constraints:
- Hosted (fastest): we can spin a dedicated GPU pool for the POC (isolated tenant) — ~3 business days to provision.
- Dedicated/Reserved: longer lead time (1-2 weeks) but gives predictable throughput and isolation.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): feasible but extends timeline (2-6 weeks depending on customer's infra).
- For PHI: we'll enable stricter KV-cache hygiene (no disk-backed caches), disable prefix caching for sensitive fields, and enable end-to-end encryption in transit + at rest with KMS.

Jordan (SRE): Pen-test operational note: if customer requests external pentest against our hosted environment, we need the exact IP ranges and test vectors up front; tests limited to the customer tenant endpoints. Also we require an escalation contact and a blackout window for heavy load tests.

Alex (AE): Pricing / commercial for POC — quick options to propose to Nexera:
- Option A: $10k usage credits for a 4-week POC (covers compute and support) + 1 SE 0.2 FTE included
- Option B: Metered at dev rate (we can share pricing sheet) and 2-week free trial for quick proof of concept

Priya (SE): Engineering ask list from our side to customer:
- Provide 50 labelled claims + 200 unlabeled for scale tests
- Provide test API/queue endpoint for routing integration (or sample messages)
- Clear acceptance criteria signoff doc (we'll draft and iterate)

Olivia (Legal): On DPA/BAA: I can start the DPA draft today. For HIPAA / BAA we need confirmation that customer is a covered entity or BA. Also: request customer's legal contact and their standard security questionnaire if they have one (we can fill it but it speeds things up if they give their primary doc).

Alex (AE): Customer asked about SOC2 and pen-test proof points right away. @Marta can we ship a minimal artifact package to Nexera by EOD tomorrow (SOC2 redacted + one-pager on pen-test policy + DPA template)?

Marta (Security): Yes — I will attach SOC2 redacted report + pen-test summary + DPA template to a secure share. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Reminder: reserved-pool provisioning request created (#REQ-4391). Estimated ready: 3 business days.

Alex (AE): Next actions / owners:
- Marta / Olivia: share SOC2, pen-test summary, DPA template (owner: Marta / Olivia) — due EOD tomorrow
- Priya: draft acceptance criteria doc & sample eval set, start baseline run (owner: Priya) — due in 3 business days
- Jordan: provision dedicated dev pool for POC or confirm timeline for private option (owner: Jordan) — update in 1 business day
- Alex: send pricing options to Nexera and collect legal contact (owner: Alex) — today

Alex (AE): Anything I'm missing? :thinking_face:

Priya (SE): One more: add a regression test to ensure redaction rules don't regress when prompt/weights change. We'll include that in the acceptance doc.

Marta (Security): Also add data subject access and deletion flow in the acceptance doc (GDPR).

Alex (AE): Great, thanks all. I'll follow up with Nexera and loop their security contact after I get the DPA draft. :thumbsup:"
